bug_semantics: Standalone FastAPI servers installed CORSMiddleware with allow_origins defaulting to ["*"] and allow_credentials=True (telemetry also allow_headers=["*"]; key-server also allow_methods/allow_headers=["*"]). Starlette reflects the request Origin when wildcard origins are combined with credentials, so any site can make authenticated cross-origin API calls as a visiting user (CWE-942). First-party GHSA-c65f-x25w-62jv names server/key-server/app/main.py and server/telemetry-server/app/main.py plus CORS_ORIGINS=* defaults; CVE-2026-74881 / GHSA-243r-jm6r-f6pp is the VulnCheck/NVD record of that advisory. Affected < 1.4.0, patched 1.4.0.
